name: T-54 / T-55 family
protection: Cast dome turret; Vietnamese upgrades add ERA, laser rangefinder and thermal sight. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm damage optics, stowage and tracks; every launcher in the game (PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) penetrates from any arc, frontal hull included at close range.
visual_notes: Rounded dome turret, five road wheels with a gap between first and second
Vietnamese modernised T-54B: ERA bricks on turret front, laser rangefinder box over the gun
External fuel tanks on right fender, rear drums; used by many Middle East/African forces too
